name: No biomarker leakage
rule: Ferritin and 25(OH)D must never appear in predictor matrices.

name: Training-only preprocessing
rule: Imputation, scaling and encoding must be fit only on training data.

name: Training-only class weighting
rule: Class weights or scale_pos_weight must be calculated using training labels only.

name: No test-driven tuning
rule: Temporal test cycles must never participate in hyperparameter selection.

name: No test-driven calibration
rule: Calibration functions must be estimated without using temporal test labels.

name: No post-hoc predictor addition
rule: Primary predictors are frozen from Stage 02B before model results.

name: No post-hoc model deletion
rule: All predefined primary model families must be reported.

name: Matched iron retained
rule: Observed and matched iron results must be analyzed in parallel.

name: P remains supplementary
rule: 2017–March 2020 must not be treated as an independent sequential cycle alongside J.

name: Multiple seeds
rule: Stochastic algorithms must be evaluated across all locked seeds.

name: Bootstrap uncertainty
rule: Primary test metrics require 95% bootstrap confidence intervals.

name: Calibration reported
rule: Discrimination alone is insufficient; Brier, calibration slope/intercept and ECE are required.

name: Resource endpoints reported
rule: Testing burden must be evaluated at predefined sensitivity targets.

name: Survey weights separate from primary ML objective
rule: Primary predictive training remains participant-level unless a later locked sensitivity analysis explicitly adds survey weighting.
